caption: The drawing depicts a ceramic container in the shape of a bird. The main body of the bird is a dark grayish-black color, with reddish-brown wings and a matching reddish-brown beak, comb, and an accent near the tail. The tail itself is elongated and colored in shades of green. The bird is positioned sitting inside a shallow, circular base that is green in color. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or decorative elements present. The composition is centered, and the bird-shaped container is the sole object depicted.
title: Carved Wooden Chicken
